    Finite extensions of a specified degree #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_finiteFieldExtension (k : Type u) [Field k] [Finite k] (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∃ (F : Type u) (x : Field F) (x_1 : Algebra k F), Finite F ∧ Module.finrank k F = n ∧ Nat.card F = Nat.card k ^ n

    Every finite field has an extension of each positive degree, with the corresponding power of the ground field's cardinality.
